title: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
name: disable-sysmain
warning: Recommended only if Windows is installed on an SSD or NVMe. Do NOT enable on mechanical HDDs.
modal: SysMain preloads apps into RAM. On fast SSD/NVMe drives it adds unnecessary background disk I/O and RAM usage, but on mechanical HDDs it helps loading times. Do you want to disable it?
description: Stops and disables the SysMain service to reduce background disk activity and free RAM on SSD/NVMe systems.
